text:
Maya: Quick weekend poll — sunflower patch picnic (Sunday morning) or indoor bouldering + tacos (Saturday afternoon)? kids/pets welcome. who’s in?
Sam: Sunflower patch for me 🌻 I’d bring a big blanket and picnic snacks.
Jules: Climbing + tacos! Need to work on my slab footwork. :muscle:
Ravi: Leaning climbing but my ankle’s still twingy. If it’s slow-paced I could try bouldering.
Ava: If rain, I vote indoor. Otherwise sunflowers are cute. any carpool options?
Maya: I can drive 3, have a roof rack for bikes. planning to leave ~9am if we do the patch.
Sam: @Maya can you bring sunscreen? last time I got roasted 🤦‍♂️
Maya: Yup sunscreen + sunglasses + a thermos for coffee.
Jules: If climbing, I can reserve mats and we can hit Tacoria on 5th after. anyone need shoes? I have a pair 39 and 41.
Ravi: Might borrow shoes from you, @Jules.
Ava: I’ll make a quick Doodle? or should we just thumbs up here? :+1: :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Poll created: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 — vote by Friday 6pm.
Sam: Voted sunflowers. :sunflower:
Jules: Voted climbing.
Maya: Voted sunflowers + carpool note.
Ravi: Voted climbing (maybe).
Ava: Voted sunflowers (rain backup: climbing).
Maya: Cool, looks split. will collect final RSVP by Friday and DM drivers. thanks! :sparkles:
